cells.gaps: No count or share of primary schools entering data is published: the one figure, nearly 80% of learners in the registry (GMB-026, August 2025), is a share of learners. The sources disagree on pilot or live: the learner register is said to be national since 2021, while GPE KIX in October 2025 (GMB-019) still calls SEMIS a pilot. Level is named only in 2022. Finance is not stated within the 36 months. GMB-001 to GMB-004 are from the excluded source and set nothing.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-12: the ministry's learner register is past its pilot and schools record learners in it, with attendance and results modules: stage 3, unchanged; no share or count of primary schools entering data is published, so not 4. The public Education Data Center launched in September 2026 sets last twelve months to advancing.
